description_en: Adds a show to a playlist
kebab_example: aliyun live add-show-into-show-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id LIVEPRODUCER_POST-cn-0pp1czt0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddShowIntoShowList

fields.help_en:
The playback duration of a single show. Unit: seconds.

You can set only one of repeatTimes and duration.
This parameter is required when resourceType is set to live
fields.help_zh:
单个节目播放时间长度，单位：秒。

repeatTimes和duration两者只允许设置其中一个。
resourceType设置为live时本参数必填
fields.name: duration

fields.help_en:
The number of times a single show is repeated. Default value: 0.

You can set only one of repeatTimes and duration.
repeatTimes specifies the number of repetitions. For example, 0 means the show is repeated 0 times (played once), 1 means the show is repeated 1 time (played twice), and so on
fields.help_zh:
单个节目播放循环次数，默认为0。

repeatTimes和duration两者只允许设置其中一个。
repeatTimes为重复次数，示例：0表示重复0次（实际播放1次），1表示重复1次（实际播放2次），以此类推
fields.name: repeat_times

fields.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

live: live streaming resource.

vod: video-on-demand resource.

pic: image resource.

When using video-on-demand (VOD) resources, use managed Bucket resources first. Resources in your own Bucket may expire. If you use resources in your own Bucket, check the resource validity period.
Live files support live streaming resources and third-party URLs.
VOD files support video-on-demand resources, image resources, and third-party URLs.
When using live streaming resources, you must also specify the duration parameter
fields.help_zh:
素材类型。取值：

live：直播素材。

vod：点播素材。

pic：图片素材。

使用视频点播（VOD）资源，可优先选择托管Bucket资源，自有Bucket资源存在过期风险，如果您选用自有Bucket资源，需注意资源的有效期时间。
直播文件可支持直播素材和第三方URL。
点播文件可支持点播素材、图片素材和第三方URL。
使用直播素材时必须同时传入duration参数
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en: The URL of the playback file
fields.name: resource_url

parameters.help_en: The list of show resources to add. Each resource has independent parameters such as showName and resourceUrl
parameters.help_zh: 需要添加的多个节目资源列表，每个资源都有独立的showName，resourceUrl等参数
parameters.name: show_list

parameters.help_en:
The production studio ID.

If you created the production studio by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html operation, check the CasterId value returned by the CreateCaster operation.

If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, navigate to ApsaraVideo Live console > Production Studios > Cloud Production Studio to view the production studio name.

The production studio name in the production studio list on the Cloud Production Studio page of the ApsaraVideo Live console is the production studio ID
parameters.help_zh:
导播台ID。

如果您通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2848009.html创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过直播控制台 > 导播台 > 云导播台路径查看导播台名称。

直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID
parameters.name: caster_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:
live: live streaming resource.
vod: video-on-demand resource.
pic: image resource.

When using video-on-demand (VOD) resources, use managed Bucket resources first. Resources in your own Bucket may expire. If you use resources in your own Bucket, check the resource validity period.
Live files support live streaming resources and third-party URLs.
VOD files support video-on-demand resources, image resources, and third-party URLs.
When using live streaming resources, you must also specify the Duration parameter
parameters.help_zh:
素材类型。取值：
live：直播素材。
vod：点播素材。
pic：图片素材。

使用视频点播（VOD）资源，可优先选择托管Bucket资源，自有Bucket资源存在过期风险，如果您选用自有Bucket资源，需注意资源的有效期时间。
直播文件可支持直播素材和第三方URL。
点播文件可支持点播素材、图片素材和第三方URL。
使用直播素材时必须同时传入duration参数
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the playback file
parameters.name: resource_url

parameters.help_en:
The playback duration of a single show. Unit: seconds.
You can set only one of RepeatTimes and Duration.
This parameter is required when ResourceType is set to live
parameters.help_zh:
单个节目播放时间长度，单位：秒。
RepeatTimes和Duration两者只允许设置其中一个。
ResourceType设置为live时本参数必填
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The number of times a single show is repeated. Default value: 0.
You can set only one of RepeatTimes and Duration.- RepeatTimes specifies the number of repetitions. For example, -1 means infinite repetition, 0 means the show is repeated 0 times (played once), 1 means the show is repeated 1 time (played twice), and so on
parameters.help_zh:
单个节目播放循环次数，默认为0。
RepeatTimes和Duration两者只允许设置其中一个。- RepeatTimes为重复次数，示例：-1表示可无限重复；0表示重复0次（实际播放1次）；1表示重复1次（实际播放2次）；以此类推
parameters.name: repeat_times

parameters.help_en: The position in the playlist where the show is inserted. Positions start from 0. By default, the show is added to the end of the current playlist
parameters.help_zh: 插入到播放列表的位置。位置从0 开始，默认添加到当前节目单的末尾
parameters.name: spot

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to add shows to the playlist in batch. Valid values:

true: Batch addition.

false: Single addition.

If this parameter is not specified or left empty, single addition is used
parameters.help_zh:
是否批量添加节目到节目单。取值：

true：批量添加。

false：单个添加。

该参数不填，取值为空时，也表示单个添加
parameters.name: is_batch_mode

failedList.description_en: The list of resources that failed to be added and the failure reasons
failedList.description_zh: 添加失败的资源列表以及失败原因信息

successfulShowIds.description_en: The list of show IDs that were successfully added
successfulShowIds.description_zh: 添加成功添加的节目ID列表
